MCP_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Generate a separate random token for your admin Muse connector. Save it for the Bearer token field in Muse.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate a separate 32-byte random key (64 hexadecimal characters). Back it up in your password manager and reuse it on every deployment of this Worker.

MUSE_NODE_ID.description: Initial setup. Enter the node ID of your authorized Muse device.

MUSE_SDK_TOKEN.description: Initial setup. Enter the Gadget SDK token used when authorizing this device.

MUSE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Initial setup. Enter the current refresh token for this device identity. Stop any executor sharing the identity before handoff.
